title: TBD physics switches
author: Starscream, Engine Lead
body: TBD, a physics sim with estimated parameters, now has four switches on the game step: pack voltage sag, ram drag in forward flight, ground effect, and a slower fold. TBD is the working name. Each one can be turned off.

The page applies ram drag as an extra world-frame force and torque on top of the wind force. A native stair hop with the new defaults still finishes and still lands. It takes longer, and the score is lower. The controller gains were left alone.
next: The browser page applies the new force and torque.
